correctness.rationale: For three agents the minimum-discrepancy rule preserves all discrepancies in [-5/6,5/6] via the 1/6 lattice, zero sum, and eligible-set cases. The four-agent adaptive adversary gives 12 direct three-step losing branches and 96 five-step branches; direct independent enumeration of all 54,241 eligible-set histories of length 0..4 verifies the greedy rule up to four arrivals. For m>=5, two global chores followed by the pair of receivers forces 3/2-2/m>1; two chores cannot force failure by a minimum-discrepancy choice. Computation is used only for the finite four-agent horizon, not arbitrary m or time.
